english.title: Drive works truck / road roller etc - no registration plate
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), drove a vehicle, namely **(..SPECIFY VEHICLE MAKE AND INDEX NUMBER..), on a road, namely **(..SPECIFY ROAD AND LOCATION..), when the registration mark assigned to the vehicle by the Secretary of State under section 23(1) of the Vehicle Excise and Registration Act 1994 was not fixed to

(A)_[the rear of ]_
(B)_[both sides of]_
(C)_[the rear of a trailer being towed by]_

a vehicle in the manner prescribed by Regulation 8 of the Road Vehicles (Display of Registration Marks) Regulations 2001
english.legislation: Contrary to section 42(1) and (2) of the Vehicle Excise and Registration Act 1994.

english.notes:
(i) See Section 42(4) to (6) for defences
(ii) Statement of Facts procedure applies - for wording see end of document.
(iii) See also related offence wording H746 (keep vehicle on road).
(iv) This offence becomes applicable to the Fixed Penalty Ticket procedure as from 01/02/2011 - S.I.2010 / 2720.
